_说明: viewer3d.html?model=lower_quarter 的清单（标准档 + 低档 glb）。坐标 = glTF（Y 朝上，米）。铁皮屋区（x −34..−2）与旧货市场（x 2..28）画在同一场景；中层底面、支撑柱、远处工厂（bg_*）只在成图里。开局六提到的两处下层地点；具体位置为仓库推断。

credit.zh: 自建模型；贴图 Poly Haven / ambientCG（CC0）
credit.en: Own model; textures Poly Haven / ambientCG (CC0)

desc.zh: 铁皮屋区西片：共墙叠建的铁皮屋，锈迹与补丁层层叠叠。
desc.en: Tin-shack quarter, west: rusted, patched shacks sharing walls and stacked upward.

desc.zh: 铁皮屋区东片：薄墙相隔，从巷子里能望见高悬的中层。
desc.en: Tin-shack quarter, east: thin-walled homes; the mid tier hangs far overhead.

desc.zh: 窄巷：排水沟、积水、水桶、晾挂的布和乱拉的电线。
desc.en: Narrow alleys: drains, puddles, water drums, hanging cloth and tangled cables.

desc.zh: 检修管廊：老旧管道常年滴水，下面积着水洼。
desc.en: Maintenance pipes: old pipes drip constantly into puddles below.

desc.zh: 旧货市场棚：回收钢材搭起的有顶市场。
desc.en: Junk market shed: a covered hall built from salvaged steel.

desc.zh: 露天摊位：竹竿撑起的防水布棚；其中一个纸品摊上摆着折起来的地图。
desc.en: Open-air stalls under tarps on poles; one paper stall has a folded map laid out.

desc.zh: 二手货：旧电器、收音机、工具、锅具、衣物、废料堆和纸张。
desc.en: Second-hand goods: old appliances, radios, tools, pots, clothes, scrap heaps and paper.

desc.zh: 暖色裸灯泡、钠灯与冷色工作灯；下层几乎没有自然光。
desc.en: Warm bare bulbs, sodium lamps and cold work lights; almost no natural light reaches the lower tier.

desc.zh: 下层地面：潮湿开裂的混凝土与泥地。
desc.en: Lower-tier ground: damp, cracked concrete and dirt.
